attempts.summary: On node1, disabled acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packets (accept_source_route) for both all/default IPv4 interfaces via a persistent /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf file. Verified runtime effect immediately, then confirmed persistence by restarting node1 (boot_id changed from f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d to 80fe4256-bcc6-480e-af2f-857670f93862, uptime reset to 7s) and re-checking that all six sysctl values remained 0 without any manual reapplication.
